title: Do not use upper case letters

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: Do not use upper case letters

slide_intent: Use normal word shapes consistently because case changes alter both reading texture and the perceived voice.
strategic_value: Sentence-style Helsinki typography can remain recognizable across otherwise varied messages.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section pairs a brief normal-case rule with contrasting case specimens.
practical_value: Keep headings and text in ordinary capitalization rather than defaulting to all caps.

content_islands.name: Case rule
content_islands.spec: State normal capital/lowercase usage below the heading.

content_islands.name: Comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the contrasting text treatments beneath the rule.

ingredient.name: Normal capitalization
ingredient.role: Maintain the intended reading texture and voice.
ingredient.application: Use initial capitals and lowercase in normal text and headings.
ingredient.scope: The source says normally; do not convert this wording into an exception-free ban.

reference_purposes.Application: The comparison demonstrates normal capitalization against an uppercase treatment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Titles and other text may not normally be written in uppercase.
